literal_meaning: মন যোগ করা (mind to add or to please the mind)
figurative_meaning_bn: পরের খুশিমতো কাজ করে সন্তুষ্ট করা
figurative_meaning_en: To please others by working according to their wishes and satisfying them
similar_in_english: To be at someone's beck and call
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় তার বন্ধুদের মন যোগায় কাজ করে।
মায়ের মন যোগানোর জন্য ছেলে যা বলে তাই করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always works to please his friends by doing as they wish.
The son does whatever his mother says to keep her happy.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on maintaining social harmony through accommodation.
